description: JCad's hand-authored r2010-appearance.dxf exported with the portable writer, plus the plain dirty-state test marker. This is JCad test data, not an Autodesk sample.

nativeValidation.method: AUDIT and independent DXFOUT confirmed group 440; native DXFOUT also retains RGB and color-book identity.

scope: Native emitted bytes are audited. Normal importer alpha and named-color retention are tested separately; the native color-book reference must be resolved exactly rather than inferred from its palette fallback.
